WelcomeTitle: A separate address for every site
WelcomeLead: Veil is installed. It creates iCloud Hide My Email addresses right in your browser. Three steps to go.
Step1Body: With your password and 2FA code. Tick “Keep me signed in”.
Step2Body: Open the extensions menu in the toolbar and click the pin next to Veil
Step3Body: From the popup, the button in email fields, or by right-clicking a field
GrantBody: Firefox doesn't grant site access to extensions automatically. Without it Veil can't see your session.
FaqSignedInA: Nothing to do — open Veil and it picks up the current session.
FaqKeepQ: Do I need “Keep me signed in”?
FaqKeepA: Yes. Without it iCloud ends the session quickly and Veil asks you to sign in again. Also choose **“Trust this browser”** when signing in.
FaqPasskeyQ: Don't sign in with a passkey
FaqPasskeyA: The extension can't see a session created by a passkey sign-in. Use your password and two-factor code.
FaqAdpA: If it's on, allow **“Access iCloud Data on the Web”** in iCloud settings on your device.
FaqContainersA: With Multi-Account Containers, sign in to iCloud in the default container — Veil can't see sessions from other containers.
Footnote: Veil is an independent open-source project. Not affiliated with Apple Inc.
